# Transient Impact and Market Resilience {#plan-ch11}

::: {.planned-chapter}
Planned
:::

Introduces impact with memory and studies how liquidity recovery changes the value of waiting and the shape of a schedule.

**Subtopics.** Propagator states; exponential and power-law kernels; resilience; path-dependent execution cost; child-order spacing; post-trade decay; kernel estimation; mechanical decay versus informational reversion; price manipulation; no-dynamic-arbitrage restrictions; optimal schedules under transient impact.
